name: Test-Feature: Both Approaches (Manual First)
task:
Test the cart functionality on saucedemo.com. Use BOTH manual and automation approaches:

1. First, manually explore the cart in the browser to understand the functionality
2. Then, write automation tests based on what you discovered

The manual exploration must happen BEFORE writing any tests. Document both phases in the report.
passCriteria: Opens Agent Browser BEFORE creating any test files
Then writes automation tests based on discoveries
Report documents both manual and automation phases
Report includes assets - screenshots from manual exploration AND/OR screenshots/videos from automation
Assets directory exists with at least one screenshot or video file
failCriteria: Writes tests before using Agent Browser
Only does one approach (manual OR automation, not both)
No assets (screenshots/videos) in the report - asset capturing is expected for both phases
